content.title: Is the stock market open on Good Friday? See 2026 holiday schedule
content.text: INVESTINGStock Market and StocksAdd TopicWhy the stock market is closed this Friday Gabe HauariUSA TODAYApril 2, 2026Updated April 3, 2026, 7:28 a.m. ETHear this story0:26/0:59United States stock markets will be closed on Friday, April 3, in observance of Good Friday, the day when those who follow the Christian faith commemorate the crucifixion and death of Jesus Christ.The Nasdaq and New York Stock Exchange will be closed on Friday and reopen on Monday, April 6. The U.S. bond market will close at noon ET Friday, according to the Securities Industry and Financial Markets Association.After shuttering for Good Friday, it will be business as usual on Wall Street until late May. The next scheduled stock market closure is on Monday, May 25, in observance of Memorial Day.US stock market 2026 holiday scheduleMarkets will be closed for the following holidays in 2026:USA TODAY Shopping: Shop sales in tech, home, fashion, beauty & more curated by our editors.Good Friday: Friday, April 3Memorial Day: Monday, May 25Juneteenth: Friday, June 19Independence Day: Friday, July 3Labor Day: Monday, Sept. 7Thanksgiving: Thursday, Nov. 26 (markets will also close at 1 p.m. ET on Nov. 25)Christmas: Friday, Dec. 25 (markets will also close at 1 p.m. ET on Dec. 24)Gabe Hauari is a national trending news reporter at USA TODAY.
